title: Next-Gen Sponsored Search: Crafting the Perfect Query with Inventory-Aware RAG (InvAwr-RAG) Based GenAI
summary: This paper presents the Inventory-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation (InvAwr-RAG) model, designed to optimize sponsored search query generation on platforms like Walmart. It addresses the challenge that many user queries don't match available ads, leading to missed revenue opportunities. By combining semantic understanding with real-time inventory data and historical success, InvAwr-RAG significantly increases ad fill rates by 68% while improving relevance for users and advertisers.
